title: Obstruct every actuator family on one Fourier line
statement: Fix any nonzero integer q and S_q={U(x)=V(q.x):q.V=0,mean V=0}. Every forcing built from actuators in S_q, with any fixed harmonics/transverse polarizations/switching, leaves this entire space invariant since (U.nabla)U=(U.q)V_prime=0. Full nonlinear dynamics is forced one-dimensional heat. For unit e perpendicular q and v=sqrt(2)M cos(2pi q.x)e/sqrt(1+4pi^2|q|^2), antipodal initial states +/-v have endpoint difference2exp(-4pi^2 nu|q|^2 tau)v. At least one exact smooth endpoint has norm>=M exp(-4pi^2 nu|q|^2 tau)/sqrt(1+4pi^2|q|^2). Zero disturbance suffices. This includes noncollinear mixed-helicity actuators e1 cos(2pi x3),e2 sin(2pi x3), but not arbitrary finite actuator families.
